exposure: Kielland's rotational forceps delivery with real-time intrapartum ultrasound guidance
cohort: 32 women in labor with normal fetuses, arrest of labor in the late second stage, and fetal head malposition requiring operative vaginal delivery
finding: Real-time intrapartum ultrasound guidance during Kielland's rotational forceps delivery facilitated successful fetal head rotation and vaginal delivery in all cases, with no instances of difficult application, blade slippage, or rotation in the wrong direction.
mod_finding: Real-time intrapartum ultrasound guidance during Kielland's rotational forceps delivery facilitated successful fetal head rotation and vaginal delivery in all cases.
